Collect garbage: mark the objects that live commits and pins reach, then rewrite the archives that hold enough dead objects

```sh
goback [global flags] gc [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--readers value` | how many objects to read at once during the mark |  | `32` |
| `--dead-ratio value` | rewrite an archive once this share of its bytes is dead |  | `0.3` |
| `--erasure-bound value` | rewrite an archive that has held dead objects this long, even below --dead-ratio |  | `336h0m0s` |
| `--min-age value` | keep every object younger than this |  | `24h0m0s` |
| `--no-sweep` | mark the live objects without rewriting any archives |  |  |
| `--temp-dir value` | directory for the mark's temporary files; the system temp directory by default |  |  |
